_: Sam's injury-matrix ruling set, 2026-07-28. Collected conversationally and transcribed here by one writer (Claude). This file is the AUTHORED SOURCE: the workbook and the derived matrix are generated from it, never hand-edited. Amended same day to add 'ribs' as a 13th region, superseding the earlier twelve and the 'ribs stay unroutable' line.

declaration.text: Any exercise/region cell with no matching rule and no exception = good. From here, 'good' is always authored, never assumed.

conflictResolutions._: Ruling 1. All five adductor/pubalgia conflicts resolve to caution. Sam's reasoning on record: caution's severity behaviour (untouched 1-3, reduced 4-5, removed 6+) matches how he would coach it, and the old pubalgia 'avoid' thinking survives in the stricter plyo exceptions, which stand.

newRegionPatternRules._: Ruling 2 + amendment + ribs follow-up. Every pattern x new-region cell not listed here carries NO rule. Sam added the pressing patterns to ribs on 2026-07-28: bench compression and overhead work are the mechanism.

newRegionMuscleRules._: Ruling 2 + amendment. Muscle-axis rules for the new regions. ribs has NO muscle-axis rules by ruling. The Traps -> neck rule was REMOVED on Sam's follow-up ruling: 'Traps' is never a primary muscle, so the rule was unreachable, and an authored rule nothing can reach is a defect, not a keepsake. Neck cover for Shrugs is now a named exception instead.

extraExceptions._: Sam's follow-up ruling. Named exercise exceptions authored directly rather than reverse-engineered from an existing rating. Shrugs is the most neck-loading lift in the pool but has primary 'Upper back' and pattern isolation_upper, so it matched no neck rule and fell to the declaration. The two chest-supported rows are bench-compressed PULLS, which the pressing rule cannot reach. Incline Y Raise joins them on Sam's ruling (2026-07-28) — same bench-compression mechanism, and its own cue says 'Chest on the incline'; it is isolation_upper, which no ribs pattern rule reaches.

conditioning._: Ruling 3 + amendment. Ruled BY HAND, no new taxonomy. STRICTER-WINS: existing avoids (sprint hamstring/calf) stand above these blanket cautions. Sam's authored principle, recorded verbatim for the future quality-grid unit: 'caution any region the modality's equipment or movement meaningfully uses; severity does the rest.'
conditioning.principle: caution any region the modality's equipment or movement meaningfully uses; severity does the rest.

sprint.note: lower body per Sam's enumeration (groin, hip, quad, knee, ankle/foot) plus hamstring/calf where existing avoid dominates; shoulder for arm drive; ribs per the amendment.

bike.note: existing knee stands; NO wrist/hand on bikes

untouched.note: Easy Bike stays unruled-to-good deliberately — it is the escape hatch. MetCon, Light Circuits, Easy Swim: existing cells stand, rest good.

routing._: Ruling 4 + amendment. Free text -> region. Entries with two targets are BLOCKED: the resolver is single-target in the mechanism, so they are recorded as ruled but NOT implemented, per Sam's own stop condition. Amended 2026-08-02 (Sam, LR-27 divergence table, PARKED_QUESTIONS_2026-08-01 §5): shin/shins -> calf ADDED (single-target), and quadricep (singular) corrected to quad — the knee route was a sheet typo.

dual._: EMPTY BY RULING. Sam ruled routing SINGLE-TARGET everywhere on 2026-07-28: hip flexor -> hip, achilles -> calf, upper back -> shoulder. Duals are off the table; episode-identity semantics (bucket equality in coachInjuryTargetResolver) stay untouched. Logged as a possible future refinement ONLY if athlete complaints expose coverage gaps.

exceptions._: Ruling 5. All 18 stand as authored. Any that now agree with the new rules dissolve into them automatically.
